jobs.title: Senior Sales Operations Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

At NetBox Labs, we're building the future of network automation. Our products power network and infrastructure management for thousands of organizations, from fast-growing startups to global Fortune 500 enterprises.

We’re hiring a Sr. Sales Operations Manager to help drive operational rigor, visibility, and execution across our global sales organization. This role will partner closely with Sales leadership to improve how we manage pipeline, forecasting, territories, account coverage, rep productivity, and overall sales performance. You’ll help establish scalable sales processes, translate data into actionable insights, and give sales leaders the visibility they need to identify gaps and improve execution. This role will also work closely with the Revenue Operations Managers on HubSpot administration, GTM systems architecture, and the integration stack.

This is a highly analytical and hands-on role for someone who can translate sales data into actionable insights, build scalable operating processes, and help sales leaders identify and address gaps in execution. You’ll play a key role in establishing the operational foundation and cadence needed to support a growing sales organization.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Partner with Sales leadership and Revenue Operations Managers to manage and continuously improve forecasting, pipeline management, and sales operating cadences.

 - Build and maintain reporting that provides visibility into pipeline coverage, conversion, sales productivity, attainment, deal progression, and forecast accuracy.

 - Analyze sales performance to identify trends, risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities to improve execution.

 - Support territory design, account segmentation, capacity planning, and account ownership processes.

 - Partner with Sales leadership on quarterly and annual planning, including targets, coverage models, and resource allocation.

 - Drive consistent sales processes and stage management across the organization, including opportunity hygiene and pipeline inspection.

 - Develop dashboards, scorecards, and analyses that enable sales leaders to make faster, data-driven decisions.

 - Partner with Finance and Revenue Operations on quota, headcount, productivity, and performance analysis.

 - Support the operational rollout of new sales processes, programs, and initiatives.

 - Identify opportunities to simplify seller workflows and improve rep productivity through process, automation, and technology.

 - Partner with Enablement to translate process changes and operational insights into seller training and adoption.

 - Maintain documentation for sales processes, rules of engagement, territory structures, and operating cadences.

 - Serve as a trusted operational partner to Sales leadership and frontline managers.



What you'll bring

 - 4+ years in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or GTM Strategy & Operations at a B2B SaaS company, including time at sub-$50M ARR where you built the process rather than inherited it

 - Owned the forecast and pipeline motion end to end, including territory and quota design, coverage modeling, and rep productivity analysis

 - Strong understanding of SaaS sales metrics, pipeline dynamics, conversion, coverage, and rep productivity.

 - Deep hands-on HubSpot and Salesforce including the ability to pull, model, and QA your own data without waiting on analytics

 - Built the reporting layer that sales leadership and the CFO actually run the business on, not dashboards that go unopened

 - Partnered directly with a CRO or VP Sales as a thought partner, and with frontline managers as a coach on their own numbers

 - Used AI and automation to remove manual work from the seller's day, with a specific example you can walk through




OUR STACK

 - CRM & Revenue Operations: HubSpot

 - Sales Intelligence & Prospecting: Apollo.io http://Apollo.io

 - Meeting Intelligence: Fathom


ABOUT NETBOX LABS:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.




OUR CULTURE AND VALUES: 

 - We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

 - Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

 - We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

 - Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.



NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.

jobs.title: People Operations Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

NetBox Labs is hiring a People Operations Manager to run the day to day operations behind a globally distributed team. We are 135 people across the US, UK, Canada, Australia, France, and Spain, and we are still growing. Every hire, change, and exit creates a contract, a benefits enrollment, a system record, and a compliance obligation under that country's rules. This role owns that work, mostly in Justworks and Deel.



Most of our headcount is in the US, so that is where the transaction volume sits. Our international population is smaller and considerably more complex, with different filing requirements and employment rules in each country. International work is a meaningful share of this job, not an occasional task.



You will also build. You will help us consolidate into a single system of record and keep people data clean enough so that the team can plan against it. You will stand up the operational infrastructure behind our leveling and compensation framework, and you will automate the manual cycles that currently take a week every quarter. You will work directly with the VP of People with real ownership of how the work gets done rather than a queue of tasks to route. 




WHO THIS IS FOR

This role is for someone who takes real pride in the craft of operations. You are fast and precise inside an HR system and you trust the record you leave behind. You notice when two systems disagree and you want to know why. You also spot the problem behind the ticket.

When something breaks twice you come back with a fix and a recommendation instead of a flag. Hand you a messy, half-defined project and you turn it into a plan. You already use AI in your own work and you would rather teach a tool to handle the repetitive part than build a better spreadsheet.

Much of this work is detailed, and it matters most when nobody has to think about it. This role is focused on making the operational foundation solid, with real latitude in how you get there.




WHAT YOU WILL OWN



Employee lifecycle operations

 - Own new hire setup end to end in Justworks, including onboarding records, and tax setup, benefits enrollment, and systems access

 - Own exits end to end, including termination processing, final pay, benefits continuation, equity coordination with Finance, and access removal

 - Process every employee change, including comp, title, level, manager, location, and employment status, with clean documentation behind each one

 - Manage employment documentation, contracts, amendments, and letters across our US and international entities

 - Serve as first line support for employee questions on pay, benefits, leave, time off, and policy

 - Maintain and improve the people operations knowledge base and process documentation



International employment and compliance

 - Own the people compliance calendar across every country we operate in, including filings, registrations, statutory deadlines, and annual returns

 - Run the operational relationship with our EOR partners, including hires, changes, exits, invoicing, and issue resolution

 - Track country specific employment requirements, including statutory leave, notice, probation, and termination rules, and escalate to Legal where judgment is needed

 - Support new country openings end to end from the operational side, working with our EOR and legal partners

 - Serve as the operational point of contact for our EMEA and APAC employees

 - Keep employee records accurate, complete, and audit ready across every entity



Benefits administration

 - Administer US and international benefits day to day, including enrollments, changes, terminations, invoicing, and vendor coordination

 - Execute open enrollment, from setup and communications through employee support and audit

 - Administer leaves of absence in coordination with our PEO, EOR, and Legal



Systems and data

 - Own data integrity in our HR system of record, including audits, permissions, workflows, and integrations

 - Execute our consolidation onto a single global system of record, partnering with the VP of People on sequencing

 - Build and maintain recurring people reporting, including headcount, attrition, and org data used by Finance and leadership

 - Maintain the level, band, and job architecture data behind our leveling and compensation framework, so the numbers leadership plans against hold up

 - Automate manual work. If a process runs on a spreadsheet and a calendar reminder, redesign it with the tools available, AI included

 - Use AI in the operational work you own, including drafting documentation and letters, summarizing country policy differences, auditing records against source systems, and first-pass reporting

 - Bring what works back to the People team as prompts, templates, and short walkthroughs, so the whole team gets faster


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 4+ years in people operations, ideally in a high growth software company under 500 people

 - Direct, hands on experience running people operations for a multi country workforce. UK and US required. Canada, EU, or APAC a strong plus

 - Benefits administration experience, including running a PEO or HRIS platform as the system of record. Justworks is a strong plus

 - Fluency with spreadsheets and HR data

 - Working fluency with AI tools in day to day operational work, with specific examples of what you automated or made faster

 - Follow through. Things you own do not fall through, and you close the loop without being asked

 - Excellent judgment with confidential information

 - Clear, direct written communication


NICE TO HAVE

 - Total rewards exposure such as comp cycle admin or benefits renewal support

 - Experience with an HRIS migration or consolidation

 - Familiarity with Deel, Culture Amp, Carta, or Ashby

 - Working knowledge of international employment mechanics, including EOR models, statutory entitlements, and country level filing obligations


OUR STACK

 - Justworks, US PEO

 - Justworks International and Deel, international employment

 - Culture Amp, performance management

 - Carta, equity

 - Ashby, recruiting

 - Notion and Slack, everything else

jobs.title: Manager, Customer Success - Americas
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

NetBox Labs is growing fast, and our Customer Success team is growing with us. We're hiring our first Manager, Customer Success for the Americas to lead, coach, and grow our CSM team.


You'll start with three CSMs covering North America and LATAM, and help drive the plan for and execution of growth. This starts as a player-coach leadership role, growing with the team to focus on people and practice.

You'll set the direction for how our CSMs run their books, turn good CSMs into great ones, and build the playbooks that let the team scale. Renewals and retention are owned by our Renewals team; your focus is adoption, value realization, customer health, and expansion signals.


You'll report to the Head of Customer Success & Support and partner closely with Renewals, Sales, Support, Solutions Engineering and Product.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Lead and develop the team

 - Manage and coach the CSMs through weekly 1:1s, account reviews, and call shadowing

 - Build individual growth plans that help each CSM grow into the next level of the role

 - Run a regular call-review and feedback practice, including scoring onboarding kickoffs against our CSM rubric

 - Hire, onboard, and ramp new CSMs as the team grows.
   

Set direction for how we run the book

 - Define what great looks like for a CSM: cadences, success plans, QBRs/EBRs, and escalation paths

 - Balance books across territories and segments so each CSM has a workload they can win with

 - Own the CSM playbooks for strategic accounts and help shape our digital-led motion for smaller accounts
   

Drive customer outcomes

 - Hold the team accountable for adoption, usage against entitlement, and customer health across the book

 - Spot risk early and work with Renewals so no renewal is a surprise

 - Partner with Sales on usage and product expansion, including CSM-sourced opportunities

 - Step into key customer relationships and escalations when it matters
   

Make the team better at the job

 - Use our CS dashboards and platforms to guide where the team spends its time

 - Bring the customer voice to Product through clear, prioritized feedback

 - Improve how the team uses key platforms (HubSpot and Pylon) and ensure we keep account data clean




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first year, you will:

 - Build a fully ramped Americas CSM team

 - Give every CSM a growth plan they own and see them grow against it

 - Ship the CSM playbook and make it how the team works day to day

 - Improve adoption and customer health across the book

 - Turn CSMs into a steady source of expansion pipeline with Sales

 - Develop at least one CSM into a bigger book or a senior role




WHO YOU ARE

 - 5+ years in Customer Success at a B2B SaaS company, with 2+ years managing or formally leading CSMs

 - A track record of coaching CSMs to grow, with examples of people you've promoted or developed into bigger roles

 - Hands-on experience running a book of mid-market and enterprise accounts, including exec-level relationships

 - Comfort with a technical product and technical buyers; you can hold your own with network and infrastructure engineers

 - Experience building playbooks, cadences, and metrics from scratch at a growing company

 - Strong judgment with data: you use health, usage, and support signals to decide where the team spends time

 - Clear, direct written and verbal communication in a fully remote team

 - Based in the Americas, able to work across North American time zones

 - Experience with SaaS companies focused on network automation, or infrastructure / DevOps tooling




NICE TO HAVE

 - Exposure to NetBox

 - Background with open-source or product-led companies where community and commercial motions overlap

 - Familiarity with HubSpot and Pylon (or similar CRM, CS, and support platforms)

 - Experience supporting LATAM customers; Spanish or Portuguese a plus

 - Experience designing digital-led or scaled CS programs alongside high-touch coverage

jobs.title: Technology Alliances Manager
jobs.description:
ROLE OVERVIEW

NetBox Labs is seeking a Technology Alliances Manager to own and scale our strategic technology ecosystem. This is a senior individual contributor role with direct business impact and high executive visibility. You will be the primary relationship owner and joint go-to-market driver for our most strategic technology partners — Red Hat Ansible, Nvidia, Cisco, HPE, Arista Networks, and Itential — with one clear mandate: open doors, drive business, and convert these relationships into revenue-producing routes to market for NetBox Labs, up to and including placement on our partners’ global price lists.

Four of our five priority partners are among the largest technology companies in the world, where executive access is earned, not given. We’re  looking for a sophisticated, alliance professional with relentless energy, initiative, and creativity — someone who builds their own momentum, navigates complex global organizations to reach the executives who matter, and is equally comfortable and productive with a senior leader in São Paulo, Bangalore, or Munich: a true citizen of the world. Reporting to the Vice President of Global Partnerships, you will work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing — and you will define the objectives and metrics by which NetBox Labs’ executive leadership tracks the alliance program’s progress.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Alliance Strategy & Executive Access

 - Own the global technology alliance strategy across Red Hat Ansible, Nvidia, Cisco, HPE, Arista Networks, and Itential, ensuring the portfolio aligns with NetBox Labs’ product vision, platform priorities, and go-to-market objectives.

 - Map the organization, build champions at every level, and convert them into VP- and C-suite sponsorship — these doors do not open by themselves.

 - Run two motions in parallel: land fast, visible wins with nimble partners like Itential while executing the longer, more complex campaigns required to break through at Cisco, HPE, Arista, and Red Hat.

 - Define partner tiering, engagement models, and investment levels across the technology alliance portfolio, and identify emerging partnership opportunities in adjacent ecosystems.

Routes to Market & Joint Go-to-Market Execution

 - Drive NetBox Labs onto partner global price lists and into resale, OEM, and marketplace programs that connect our products to partner sales organizations worldwide.

 - Design and launch joint GTM programs — co-sell motions, joint solution packaging, co-marketing campaigns, and field enablement — with success measured in programs launched and partner-influenced pipeline.

 - Build multi-year joint business plans and lead complex commercial engagements, including contract negotiations, pricing strategy, and incentive structures.

 - Partner with Sales team on account planning, opportunity identification, and co-selling with partner field organizations, and partner with Marketing on co-branded content, joint events, and demand campaigns.

Product & Integration Alignment

 - Serve as the voice of the partner in internal product planning, ensuring partner integration requirements and joint roadmap opportunities are reflected in NetBox Labs’ priorities.

 - Work  with Engineering and Product to scope and deliver certified integrations and joint solutions that create tangible customer value.

 - Maintain command of partner platform roadmaps, capabilities, and certification programs, and position NetBox Labs strategically within them.

Executive Metrics & Alliance Governance

 - Define the objectives, KPIs, and scorecards for the technology alliance program — and build the reporting rhythm that enables NetBox Labs’ executive leadership to track and monitor progress with clarity and confidence.

 - Establish governance frameworks for each alliance: executive business reviews, partner lifecycle management, performance tracking, and long-range strategic planning sessions.

 - Report data-driven results to leadership: programs launched, integration adoption, partner-influenced pipeline, and route-to-market milestones such as price-list placement and partner-status achievements.

Cross-Functional & Global Representation

 - Operate as the internal champion for technology alliances, building simple, repeatable playbooks that help internal teams and partner stakeholders co-sell and co-market effectively.

 - Represent NetBox Labs at partner summits, industry forums, and ecosystem events worldwide, engaging partner executives across regions, cultures, and time zones.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5-7+ years of experience in technology alliances, business development, or strategic partnerships within enterprise software, SaaS, or infrastructure technology — including direct experience with one or more priority partners (Cisco, Red Hat Ansible, Nvidia, HPE, Arista Networks, or similar network infrastructure and automation vendors).

 - A track record of earning executive sponsorship inside matrixed global organizations and converting it into commercial outcomes — global price list placement, resale or OEM agreements, marketplace listings, or equivalent routes to market.

 - Self-generated energy, initiative, and creativity: you build your own momentum, hunt for opportunity, and never sit back waiting for the business to come to you.

 - Demonstrated ability to define alliance objectives, metrics, and scorecards, and to communicate progress to executive leadership in clear, data-driven terms.

 - Deep domain expertise in network automation, network infrastructure, or IT operations technology — credible with both technical and business audiences at partner organizations.

 - Demonstrated executive presence and global refinement: culturally fluent, polished, and effective when engaging with senior executives throughout the Americas, APAC, and EMEA.

 - Proven ability to align stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing without direct authority.

 - Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; an advanced degree is a plus.




PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

 - Experience with open source ecosystems or community-driven platform businesses; familiarity with network source of truth, IPAM, DCIM, or automation tooling such as Ansible, Nornir, or Terraform.

 - Background in product management, solutions engineering, or technical pre-sales — fluency in integration architecture discussions.

 - A successful record in large, complex deal negotiations; experience with hyperscaler marketplaces, global price lists, or channel/alliance programs at major technology vendors.

 - Understanding of agentic AI, MCP (Model Context Protocol), or API-first platform architectures and how they are reshaping enterprise infrastructure management.

 - International experience — living, working, or managing alliances across regions; additional languages are a plus.

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
NetBox Labs is looking for a Content Marketing Manager with [4+] years of experience to scale its integrated marketing campaigns to the next level. Reporting to our Vice President of Marketing, you will be responsible for the creation of multiple content channels, drive brand maturity and consistency, and enhance our content marketing engine. This is a hands-on, high-visibility role that will be responsible for both strategy and execution while working closely with executives and a cross-functional team. Your ultimate goal is to establish the brand and content foundations for an innovative, rapidly-scaling, and market-defining business.



You will be responsible for:

 - Developing and executing a content marketing strategy aligned with GTM goals

 - Creating persona-based content for all stages of the marketing and sales funnel on key use cases

 - Producing high-impact, AEO/SEO-optimized blog content, in-depth ebooks and whitepapers, external sales collateral, videos etc.

 - Keeping your finger on the pulse of sales conversations, industry trends, and the NetBox ecosystem and using those findings to craft meaningful content assets that drive engagement with key audiences

 - Driving campaign effectiveness through measurement of content conversion and testing

 - On occasion, writing and editing email or web copy for marketing and sales use cases



You will work closely with:

 - Product marketing, growth marketing, and partner sales to develop on-message assets for go-to-market campaigns

 - External communications leader to ensure consistency in brand standards and overall message

 - Community marketing to amplify our community’s contributions and the NetBox brand

 - People team to align our content with the values and culture of the company and community and shape the way NetBox Labs connects with current and potential employees

 - Customer success, engineering, and product teams to support their audiences and tell their stories



It would be fantastic if you have the following background:

 - [4+] years as a brand and content marketer building programs and processes from the ground up and directly executing brand and content strategies

 - Excellence in all facets of content creation including creative ideation, project management, editorial operations, and production

 - Portfolio of compelling content across multiple channels, including blogs, eBooks, podcasts, videos,

 - A creative and strategic mindset and experimentalist approach for leveraging content and brand assets to maximize brand impact, reach, and demand gen

 - Direct experience in enterprise SaaS and networking or comfort with highly technical audiences and content

 - Strong communication, interpersonal and cross-functional collaboration skills

 - Excellent writing and editorial skills

 - Experience working in a fast-paced startup environment

 - Experience in both inbound and outbound demand generation
